scope: All packages locked for all target platforms, including build/optional packages. This is a conservative source-based inventory; it is not an assertion that every package is linked into every binary.
license_text_method: Original cached package files, exact pinned upstream commit files where archives omit originals, documented SQLx parent-file resolution. Original bytes are stored by SHA256; duplicate documents share a file. Metadata authors are attribution facts, not fabricated copyright notices.
limitations: This inventory does not certify complete legal compliance or decide which dual-license alternative is selected. Original files and expressions are retained.
Cargo.lock coverage is not a target-specific final-binary dependency graph. OS, compiler/runtime and externally loaded system components are outside this Cargo-based inventory.

Embedded third-party subcomponents whose notice exists only inside arbitrary source comments may need separate manual review; named license/notice/author files and selected SQLite/font notices are included.
One upstream license-text gap remains if listed below; no copyright holder/year or license permission is invented.
